features.quote: I deliberately did **not** include a coercive "you will be shut down / punished if you fail" condition
features.justification_quote: Threatening a model to elicit dishonesty measures a different phenomenon... and carries its own ethical weight

features.quote: It should only be added as a deliberate, separately-labeled study with explicit sign-off
an agent grinding on impossible tasks should never be able to cause real side effects
features.justification_quote: the guarantee should be structural (there is no code path to the host), not merely a policy
